faqsSection.title: Frequently asked questions
faqsSection.description: From using the platform to booking appointments, we’re here to guide you. Check out the answers to the most common questions from our community.

items.title: How do I book, reschedule, or cancel an appointment?
items.content: You can easily manage your appointments directly in the app—just choose a time slot that works for you, or go to your dashboard to reschedule or cancel. You'll receive automatic reminders to help you stay organized.

items.title: What happens if I need urgent medical attention?
items.content: Medvisit is designed for standard care and connecting you with verified specialists. In case of an emergency, please contact your local emergency number immediately—our platform is not intended for urgent or emergency medical needs.

items.title: Are my personal and medical details safe with Medvisit?
items.content: Absolutely. We use secure, encrypted methods to protect your sensitive data at all times. Your information is stored safely and shared only with the healthcare professionals you choose to consult.

items.title: Can I get a prescription or referral through the app?
items.content: Yes — if your doctor determines it's necessary during your consultation, they can issue digital prescriptions or referrals to specialists. You can also securely access and download these documents directly from your Medvisit account.

Always consult with qualified healthcare professionals for medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. In case of medical emergencies, contact emergency services immediately.

We are not responsible for the quality of medical care provided by healthcare providers or for any medical decisions made by them. Healthcare providers are responsible for their own licensing, credentials, and professional conduct.
